title: GoldSrc Flint'N'Powder Sounds
description: Makes Flint'N'Powder's weapons sound more like older videogame firearms.
body:
Replaces the gunshot and reloading sounds from Flint'N'Powder with similar sounds from GoldSrc engine-based shooter games. Also includes explosion sound replacements. 

Any sounds that don't apply have instead been frequency-crushed to fit the glorious low sound quality of 1999.

**_This mod also replaces firework sounds, because one of the guns use those instead of from the mod itself._**

Flint'N'Powder: https://modrinth.com/mod/flintnpowder

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/rrsKBQeHGeE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

_This resource pack uses audio originating from GoldSrc-based games such as Half-Life and Counter Strike. Some of them have been edited with Audacity._
